## Site map

- `/` — Home: hero, selected systems, operator axis, signal journal preview
- `/work` — Work index: case studies with problem/decision/proof framing
- `/work/naavis` — NAAVIS case study (privacy-first autonomous intelligence system)
- `/projects` — Public build archive (~20 open-source security and AI repositories)
- `/experience` — Work experience: verified roles, companies, dates, outcomes
- `/achievements` — Certifications (CEH, CNSP, PEH, IELTS 7.5) and verified recognition
- `/publications` — Patents and intellectual property
- `/journal` — Signal journal: operating notes on systems and security design
- `/about` — Profile: bio, experience timeline, education, credentials
- `/now` — Currently in motion: active builds
- `/contact` — Contact channel

- Founding Engineer at Pawan Technologies; Founder of Shadownik venture (DavCreations)
- Certifications: CEH (EC-Council), CNSP (The SecOps Group), PEH (TCM Security), IELTS 7.5
- TryHackMe Top 25%; CyVIT CTF rank 36; co-inventor on a filed patent (202421032123)
- Focus areas: application security, SIEM, AI systems, ESP32/wireless research, secure product delivery
